description: Premium Body Polish, pH Neutral with Wax and Silicone Protection, Glossy Finish, Water-Repellent, for All Automotive Paint Finishes (200ml) - Distributed/Packaged by Hanuels. Product Details: Hanuels Premium Body Polish is crafted to bring out the very best in your vehicle's appearance. Formulated with advanced silicone and wax emulsions, this premium polish delivers a deep, mirror-like gloss that enhances paint depth and colour richness, giving your car a true showroom-worthy finish. The smooth, slick formula spreads effortlessly across all automotive paint finishes, leaving behind a water-repellent surface that helps protect against dust and environmental contaminants. Application is straightforward — simply apply four dime-sized drops onto a medium foam finishing pad, spread across a 2x2 area, and buff off any residual haze immediately using a high-density, clean microfiber towel. Before application, ensure the surface is clay-decontaminated, dry, and cool to the touch for best results. Whether you are maintaining a daily driver or detailing a prized vehicle, Hanuels Premium Body Polish offers long-lasting shine and protection with every use, making it an essential addition to your car care routine.
